prompt: A single object shown alone as a game asset, three-quarter front view: The hanging underside of a small round floating sky isle: a huge inverted cone of pale cream layered limestone rock, round in plan, perfectly flat and level on top, tapering down in chunky stepped rock ledges and hanging stalactite masses to one blunt point at the bottom, wider than it is tall. Viewed from slightly above so the flat round top is visible. Whole rock in frame. Thick chunky proportions, nothing thin. Hand-painted stylized game art, mid-level detail, chunky readable shapes, softer muted colours. Plain light grey background, even soft lighting, no cast shadows, no text, no labels.
